input: Set a savings target for a home down payment

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The target down payment percentage (e.g., 5%, 10%, 20%) directly sets the total savings number and affects mortgage options, PMI requirements, and monthly costs.
The target location and property type (city, suburb, condo, house) determines the realistic home price range, which is the foundation of the entire savings calculation.
The desired timeline for purchasing sets the required monthly savings rate and determines whether the goal is achievable with current income.
Whether saving alone or with a partner changes the total income available to save, the combined savings rate, and how contributions are tracked.
Knowing the current savings already set aside tells us the gap that still needs to be filled and shapes the urgency of the plan.
How aggressively the user wants to save — sacrificing lifestyle vs. a balanced approach — determines what monthly savings amount is acceptable to them.
What the user wants as an output (a simple number, a month-by-month savings schedule, advice on savings vehicles) shapes what a completed plan actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Set a savings target for a home down payment
gold.taskDescription: Define a clear, realistic savings goal and plan to accumulate a down payment for purchasing a home.

questions.title: What down payment percentage are you aiming for?
questions.description: Determine the target down payment percentage (e.g., 5%, 10%, 20%) the user wants to put down, as this directly sets the total savings number.

questions.title: What city or region are you looking to buy in?
questions.description: Identify the target location and property type to establish a realistic home price range as the basis for the savings calculation.

questions.title: When do you want to be ready to buy?
questions.description: Capture the user's intended purchase timeline (e.g., 2 years, 5 years) to calculate the required monthly savings rate.

questions.title: Are you saving alone or with a partner?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a solo or joint savings effort, as combined income and contributions significantly change the plan structure.

questions.title: How much have you already saved toward this goal?
questions.description: Establish the current savings baseline to calculate the remaining gap and adjust the monthly savings target accordingly.

questions.title: How aggressively do you want to save each month?
questions.description: Understand whether the user prefers a strict, maximum-savings approach or a balanced plan that preserves their current lifestyle.

questions.title: What should the final plan actually include?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a simple savings number, a monthly breakdown, recommendations on savings accounts or investment vehicles, or a full milestone schedule.
